# JWT

Decode JWTs and verify signatures (HMAC, RSA, ECDSA, EdDSA).

Category: Encoders · ID: `jwt` · Search terms: token, bearer, jws, auth, claims

## Command line

```bash
devtooltui jwt [file-A|-] [file-B|-] [flags]
```

## Inputs

1. Token (argument 1)
2. Public key (PEM, optional) (argument 2)

## Options

| Flag | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--secret` | text | `` | Secret. Verifies HS256/384/512 signatures |

## Examples

From the tests (`testdata/jwt`), so they are what the tool prints.

### hs256-no-secret

Input:

```text
eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiIxMjM0NTY3ODkwIiwibmFtZSI6IkphbmUgRG9lIiwiYWRtaW4iOnRydWUsImlhdCI6MTc2NzIyNTYwMCwiZXhwIjoxNzY3MzEyMDAwfQ.0UbpErT9s1mW7DPhY7a3zVcAIcoiMxmRWlvGX7wD3e8
```

Output:

```text
── Header
{
  "alg": "HS256",
  "typ": "JWT"
}

── Payload
{
  "sub": "1234567890",
  "name": "Jane Doe",
  "admin": true,
  "iat": 1767225600,
  "exp": 1767312000
}

── Dates
exp: 2026-01-02 00:00:00 UTC (in 12 h)
iat: 2026-01-01 00:00:00 UTC (12 h ago)

── Signature
not verified (type the secret in the options)
```

### rs256-bearer

Input:

```text
Bearer eyJhbGciOiJSUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCIsImtpZCI6ImsxIn0.eyJzdWIiOiJzdmMiLCJuYmYiOjE3NjczOTg0MDAsImV4cCI6MTc2NzQ4NDgwMH0.ZmlybWEtZmFsc2E
```

Output:

```text
── Header
{
  "alg": "RS256",
  "typ": "JWT",
  "kid": "k1"
}

── Payload
{
  "sub": "svc",
  "nbf": 1767398400,
  "exp": 1767484800
}

── Dates
exp: 2026-01-04 00:00:00 UTC (in 2 d)
nbf: 2026-01-03 00:00:00 UTC (in 36 h)

── Signature
not verified: RS256 needs the public key (paste it in the second input)
```
